script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars at 15° Aquarius squares your ruler Venus at 15° Taurus in your 1st House of Self, a hard aspect exacting today. This pits your 10th House Career demands against your core identity—as an earth sign, your steadfastness is under siege. If partnered, expect heated debates over money or values; Venus in your 1st House amplifies your sensitivity to any perceived criticism. Singles: you’ll attract intense, unconventional types but may confuse aggression with devotion. Mars in your 10th House pushes for professional boldness, yet its square to Venus warns: don’t sacrifice self-worth for status. A sudden offer may test your 2nd House of income—scrutinize every clause. AVOID luxury spending; Mars distorts your Venusian taste, ensuring regret. Subscribe now for tomorrow’s navigation guide.
